title: Throwable Arrows
description: This mod makes it so you can throw arrows, this could be useful and fun for some players who would like that feature.
body: This mod makes it so you can throw arrows, this could be useful and fun for some players who would like that feature. Some players might want to throw arrows, is that player you? If so, this mod is for you! This mod adds the ability to throw arrows in minecraft, it can also be used to attack mobs, which makes it a good attacking weapon.
